items.title: Benjie White Interview, 1961-03-16
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And the title of the music is Owl's Who, composed by E.H. Farrell and W.B. White... [INTERVIEWEE] That's right.

ctx.x: Yeah, that's where I lived at that time.

And the title of the music is Owl's Who, composed by E.H. Farrell and W.B. White of the United States, arranged by Owl Orchestra. Copy deposited, Maladine. Copy received, December the 31st, 1925. And the number is 629540.
